verdict.rationale: Beamer's own docs say it lets you 'collect and prioritize feedback', and its pricing lists a 'Public and private roadmap', which loosely points to a public-facing feedback capability. Nothing documents a portal where customers submit ideas or vote on them. Comments and reactions on changelog posts are a related feature, not idea voting. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented public feedback/ideas portal, customer idea submission, upvoting/voting on ideas, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can host a public feedback portal where customers submit and vote on ideas

citations.quote: Now, you can easily collect and prioritize feedback—and know how to build more value into your product.
